style.vernacular: No permanent buildings on Heard Island. The cleared Atlas Cove ANARE station (1947-55, about 25 buildings) and 1928 Admiralty Hut survive only as ruins; remains are small weathered huts and modified water-tank shelters of corrugated iron and timber in faded orange and grey, among black volcanic rock and sand, glaciers and storm-swept cushion-plant tussocks.
style.ornament: None; utilitarian field huts, fuel drums, flagpoles, rusted try pots, a small mast and stencilled blank boards. Orange paint is the only accent.

sources.what: Atlas Cove station: ~25 buildings, cleared, recreation-hut ruins; water-tank shelters; Admiralty Hut 1928 ruins; Antarctic climate; Azorella, no trees; volcanic geology
